label: Работающий
description: A 10-sentence card for работающий, the present active participle of работать.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative. Работающий comes from работать via the present stem of работают plus -щ- and an ending. It agrees with masculine отец and means the father who is working.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative. The feminine ending -ая lets работающая agree with мать, marking the mother who is working.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative. Работающее takes the neuter ending -ее to match радио, describing the radio that keeps running and working.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative. The plural ending -ие joins работающие to люди, picking out the working people who hurry to the plant.
Strategic focus: Masculine accusative. With the animate object соседа the participle takes -его, so работающего agrees in gender, number and case as the neighbour I respect.
Strategic focus: Feminine genitive. Работающей carries the feminine genitive ending to agree with сестры, marking whose salary it is — the salary of the working sister.
Strategic focus: Masculine dative. The dative object инженеру pulls работающему into the dative -ему ending, naming the engineer who is working and being paid.
Strategic focus: Masculine instrumental. After доволен the noun помощником stands in the instrumental, and работающим takes the matching instrumental ending to agree with the working assistant.
Strategic focus: Feminine prepositional. The preposition о governs the prepositional case, so бабушке and работающей both take prepositional endings as the grandmother we care about.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative paraphrase. Работающие машины unfolds as машины, которые работают — machines that are working. The participle compresses that который-clause into one agreeing word.
